`Gson.getAdapter(TypeToken<T>)` (`Gson.java:340`):

- Otherwise consults a `ThreadLocal<Map<TypeToken<?>, TypeAdapter<?>>>` and installs a `FutureTypeAdapter` placeholder before resolving — this is the guard against infinite recursion for cyclic/self-referencing types (e.g. a `Node` class with a `Node next` field): if `MyType` refers to itself, the recursive `getAdapter` call gets the in-flight `FutureTypeAdapter` instead of looping forever.

(`gson/src/main/java/com/google/gson/internal/bind/ReflectiveTypeAdapterFactory.java:110`)

(`ReflectiveTypeAdapterFactory.java:503`, shared by `FieldReflectionAdapter` and `RecordAdapter`)

A accumulator = createAccumulator();      // FieldReflectionAdapter: constructor.construct()
in.beginObject();
